title: path_coverage.json
description: The counts of one path coverage run: every decision of every covered file, the paths each took, the totals, and each method's card. Decisions are named path:line:column, the path relative to the run's root.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, naming the version the file follows.

decisions.description: Each decision's operands, in order, each with how often it was truthy and falsy.

paths.description: Each decision's leaves, as line:column spans, and every possible path with how often it was taken.

outside.description: Each path taken that a treatment rules out, so a wrong treatment is reported, never dropped.

reached.description: How often each statement that is no decision, and each method's entry, was reached; absent when not known, eg in a report the post reporter sent.

totals.description: The paths taken of all possible, as [taken, possible]: alone, each decision's paths on their own, and combined, through each method's decisions; with groups configured, each group's own.

cards.description: Each method's card, under its def's name, and each top card, for decisions outside every method, under its first line's start.

tree.description: How each card's rows nest: by file, then card line:column, then row line:column.

kinds.description: The kinds of decision measured; a run measuring other kinds lists its paths differently, so runs merge only when these match.

ignored.description: The operators whose decisions were not measured, eg &&=.

measured_by.description: Each tool that parsed or measured the run, by name, and its version, eg the language, its parser and path_coverage itself; any of them can find a file's decisions or paths differently, so runs merge only when these are equal.

treats.description: Each treatment: the method, what it is treated as, and the glob it is limited to, or null.

decisionName.description: path:line:column, line from 1, column in characters from 0.

operand.description: How often an operand was truthy and falsy; only names the one outcome a fixed leaf can have.

takenPaths.description: Paths, each its leaves' outcomes in order, with how often it was taken. An outcome is true, false, null for a leaf not reached, or a word, eg 2+ items.

name.description: The method's name, or a top card's scope, eg its class, or file.

ways.description: The ways one call can go through the card, its decisions multiplied as they nest.

calls.description: How often the method was called; null for a top card, or when not known.

top.description: What the row is, eg &&, if/else, return.

taken.description: How many of its paths were taken; null when not known.

decision.description: The row's decision, null for a row that is no decision, eg a return.

taken.description: The ways the method's calls took, whole, each with how many calls took it; empty when never called. Absent for a top card, which no call runs.

way.description: The rows one call ran, in order: a decision row's at and the path it took, or a statement row's at alone.

at.description: The row's at, as the card's rows have it.

place.description: Where a row runs: inside parent's row, in its arm, on the indices of its possible paths, inside its leaf-th leaf, giving that leaf each outcome in gives; each null where it does not apply.
